description: One recorded access-control rule change. Holds identifiers and the rule's shape only, never token text.

id.description: The unique ID of the audit entry.

actorPrincipal.description: The principal that made the change.

actorClient.description: The OAuth client the actor's token was issued to; absent when unknown.

ruleId.description: The access-control rule the change was about.

identity.description: The identity of the rule as it was written.

resource.description: The resource of the rule as it was written.

operation.description: The operation of the rule as it was written.

conditions.description: The rule's conditions as written, normalized.

reason.description: The operator-supplied explanation; absent when none was given.

correlationId.description: The request ID of the request that made the change; absent for startup work.
